title: euphrasia mollis
intro: Euphrasia mollis, commonly known as the gentle eye, is a plant species within the family Gentianaceae. It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, traditionally used in herbal medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Euphrasia mollis include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with conjunctivitis and other eye infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
